The '''ST-9x.4 Starfighter Slave System''' was a model of [[slave circuit]] produced by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. The slave circuit sold for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and allowed a ship to be operated remotely.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
